blocks.prompt: 12. Find the general solution of the differential equation \(x\sin x\,dx + \ln y\,dy = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan to variables pehle hi alag hain: \(x\) sirf \(dx\) ke saath aur \(y\) sirf \(dy\) ke saath.
Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Asal kaam integration ka hai: \(\int x\sin x\,dx\) aur \(\int\ln y\,dy\) dono integration by parts se hote hain.
Plan: dono integrals by parts se nikal kar jorenge aur constant lagayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x\sin x\,dx + \ln y\,dy = 0\), \(y > 0\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Separable hai, balke pehle se alag hai. Term by term integrate karenge; dono integrals ke liye integration by parts \(\int u\,dv = uv - \int v\,du\) lagega.

Integrals likhein
\[\int x\sin x\,dx + \int\ln y\,dy = C\]
Kyun: Dono terms ko integrate kiya; right side par zero ka integral sirf ek constant hai.

Pehla integral (\(u = x\), \(dv = \sin x\,dx\))
\[\int x\sin x\,dx = -x\cos x + \int\cos x\,dx\]
\[= -x\cos x + \sin x\]
Kyun: \(du = dx\) aur \(v = -\cos x\). \(u = x\) is liye chuna ke differentiate karne par woh 1 ban jata hai aur bacha hua integral aasaan ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: \(v = -\cos x\) ka minus, \(-\int v\,du\) mein \(+\int\cos x\,dx\) ban jata hai.

Doosra integral (\(u = \ln y\), \(dv = dy\))
\[\int\ln y\,dy = y\ln y - \int y \cdot \dfrac{1}{y}\,dy\]
\[= y\ln y - y\]
Kyun: \(\ln y\) ka seedha integral yaad nahi hota, is liye usay \(\ln y \cdot 1\) samajh kar by parts lagaya: \(du = \frac{1}{y}\,dy\), \(v = y\). Bacha hua integral \(\int 1\,dy = y\).

Jorein
\[-x\cos x + \sin x + y\ln y - y = C\]
\[y\ln y = y + x\cos x - \sin x + C\]
Kyun: \(y\ln y\) ke ilawa sab terms right par bhej deen, har term ka sign badal gaya. Kitab ka jawab isi shakal mein hai.

Tasdeeq
\(y\ln y - y - x\cos x + \sin x = C\) ko differentiate karein:
\[(\ln y + 1)\dfrac{dy}{dx} - \dfrac{dy}{dx} - \cos x + x\sin x + \cos x = 0\]
\[\ln y\dfrac{dy}{dx} + x\sin x = 0\]
Kyun: \(y\ln y\) par product rule, \(x\cos x\) par bhi product rule. \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) aur \(\cos x\) wali terms cancel ho gayin. \(dx\) se multiply karne par di hui equation mil gayi.
blocks.final_answer: \(y\ln y = y + x\cos x - \sin x + C\)
